---
title: "NYC Weather Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: scroll
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
library(p8105.datasets)

weather_df =
  ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10
  ) |>
  filter(
    year >= 2010,
    year <= 2015,
    !is.na(tmax),
    !is.na(tmin)
  )

monthly_weather =
  weather_df |>
  group_by(year, month) |>
  summarize(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax),
    mean_tmin = mean(tmin),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month_date = as.Date(
      paste(year, as.integer(month), "01", sep = "-")
    )
  )
```

## Column {data-width="550"}

### Monthly Temperature Trends

```{r temperature-trends, echo=FALSE}
trend_plot =
  monthly_weather |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month_date)) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = mean_tmax, color = "Maximum"),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = mean_tmin, color = "Minimum"),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Maximum" = "#B45F52",
      "Minimum" = "#4A8495"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Temperature (°C)",
    color = "Temperature",
    title = "Average Monthly Temperatures"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(trend_plot)
```

### Temperature Distribution by Month

```{r temperature-boxplot, echo=FALSE}
box_plot =
  weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = month,
    y = tmax,
    fill = month
  )) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Maximum Temperature (°C)",
    title = "Monthly Temperature Distribution"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplotly(box_plot)
```

## Column {data-width="450"}

### Maximum vs. Minimum Temperature

```{r temperature-scatter, echo=FALSE}
set.seed(8105)

scatter_df =
  weather_df |>
  slice_sample(n = min(3000, nrow(weather_df)))

scatter_plot =
  scatter_df |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = tmin,
    y = tmax,
    color = factor(year),
    text = paste0(
      "Date: ", date,
      "<br>Min: ", round(tmin, 1), "°C",
      "<br>Max: ", round(tmax, 1), "°C"
    )
  )) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.55,
    size = 1.4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Minimum Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Maximum Temperature (°C)",
    color = "Year",
    title = "Daily Temperature Relationship"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(scatter_plot, tooltip = "text")
```
